rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the fruit

items.question: What fruit is gained by properly performing a hundred sacrifices?
premises: A hundred sacrifices may be properly performed.
Such performance yields a specific fruit.
This fruit can be obtained as a result.
items.inference: Properly performing a hundred sacrifices produces a fruit that one would obtain.
items.plain_english: One would obtain the fruit that comes from properly performing a hundred sacrifices.
